Auto-orders in three steps

No code and no separate bot service. Your TradingView alert sends a keyword, and the DivAlarm app on your phone does the rest.

  1. Add your exchange key

    In the app, pick Binance, Bybit, OKX, Bitget or Gate and paste an API key with futures trading permission.

    BinanceBybitOKXBitgetGate
    API Key
    ••••••••••••3F2aSaved
    Permission: futures trading. Withdrawals off.

  2. Make a keyword rule

    Choose a keyword, such as AA, and what it does: market or limit order, size, leverage, take-profit and stop-loss.

    AAwhen this keyword arrives
    LongBTCUSDTMarket10×
    TP 2%SL 1%

  3. Send it from TradingView

    Paste your DivAlarm webhook URL into a TradingView alert and put the keyword in the message. When the alert fires, your phone places the order and tells you the result.

    TradingView alert message
    AA {{ticker}} {{close}}
    Order placed: BTCUSDT long, market

You stay in control

  • Your phone signs every orderTradingView alerts carry only your keyword. Your API key and secret never go into an alert message.
  • Trading permission is enoughDivAlarm never needs withdrawal permission. Keep withdrawals switched off on the key you create.
  • One switch stops ordersTurn Auto-Order off at any time. Your alarms keep ringing.
  • Every result is recordedEach order sends a notification with the result and stays in the order log.

Auto-orders use real money on leveraged futures, and there is no paper-trading mode. Start with a small size. Auto-Order requires Pro.
